title: Index Multi-Site hostname routing and telemetry attribution

opportunity.rootCause: SiteRegistry.Resolve and hostname-only telemetry attribution scanned every Site in the active snapshot before checking hostnames, producing O(S) work on each request as the Multi-Site configuration grew.
opportunity.scope: SiteRegistry, SiteMatcher, and request telemetry attribution

implementation: Added an immutable case-insensitive hostname index to each atomically replaced SiteRegistry state.
Changed route resolution to perform an indexed hostname lookup and then evaluate only the matched Site's bounded path-prefix list while preserving longest-prefix semantics.
Added an indexed SiteRegistry.MatchHostname API and switched pathless telemetry attribution to use it, avoiding a second full-snapshot scan.

tddRed.reason: The new routing-index test suite initially could not compile because SiteRegistry had no MatchHostname API (CS1061); the index/source contract was absent.

excludedEnvironmentGates: SiteEndpointReadBudgetTests (stale source contract expecting ListAsync in manual health endpoint)
SiteHealthProbeTests (loopback socket AccessDenied in this environment)

boundaries: Large live Site-count routing latency benchmark
Live PostgreSQL persistence and concurrent multi-instance execution
CodeQL/SARIF, external penetration testing, load/SLO, SIEM, Authenticode signing, and production certification
